scope: Bounded engineering successor: explicit final-output solid-count and volume requirements. Not a novel learned model or a confirmatory scientific study.
authorization: User attached start-to-finish research audit and improvement request, with an explicit honest-terminal-result rule.
question: Can explicitly declared aggregate final-solid requirements be evaluated from the backend inspection while retaining distinct construction-history semantics and failing closed on invalid evidence?
hypothesis: Separate geometric_relation probes can correctly enforce positive integral solid count and positive volume with an explicit absolute tolerance, when bound to exactly all declared outputs and a valid final inspection.
falsifier: Any wrong aggregate accepted, invalid inspection accepted, probe ambiguity ignored, historical probe changed, or claim of hole identity based only on aggregate values.

specification.binding_scope: feature_ids must equal FeatureProgram.outputs in order, with no duplicates or missing ids; all outputs must exist in the program
specification.output_solid_count: value unitless, strictly positive integer; tolerance omitted or zero; actual positive integer, bool rejected; equality is exact
specification.output_volume: value mm3, strictly positive finite; tolerance must be explicit finite and nonnegative; |actual - expected| <= tolerance, no relative tolerance
specification.inspection: valid_brep must be exactly True; solid_count positive integral non-bool; volume_mm3 positive finite non-bool; extents three positive finite non-bool values
specification.source_of_measurement: Existing verified export path measures the reimported STEP. Direct pure API callers supply inspection evidence and are responsible for its authenticity.
specification.historical_probes: feature_presence and feature_count retain feature_history basis unchanged

development_matrix: wrong unit, fractional/zero count, missing/negative tolerance
invalid B-Rep, invalid count, nonfinite/overflow/negative/boolean measurements
missing/duplicate/local/changed output scope and unknown probe keys
equal-volume shifted hole remains indistinguishable by aggregates
unchanged-must requirement preservation and hash mismatch
stopping_rule: Stop at the fixed budget or a complete bounded receipt. Preserve every failure. Unsupported broader hypotheses remain unproved; do not iterate until positive.
execution: Local standard-library/scoped pure-Python checks only below the 512 MiB admission floor. No native CAD, installations, full suite, tensors or meshing locally unless the unchanged two-sample resource gate passes. Hosted execution may test a separate exact commit.
protected_boundary: No changes or reruns of terminal compiler studies, v2/v3 frozen protocols, protected tasks, paper results or immutable alpha. All new examples are authored engineering development cases.
checkpoint_1_research: NO_GO_NOVELTY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; verification and preservation already exist in primary literature
